roleContext.roleTitle: Senior Project Manager, Plant Automation Retrofits
roleContext.jobDescription: The plant automation retrofit programme replaces control systems in the company's bottling plants while they keep running. The Senior Project Manager is the accountable project manager of record on retrofit projects: signs the project charter and the stage-gate submissions, holds the project budget under the programme's delegated limits, runs the plant shutdown windows with the plant managers, and directs the project engineers assigned to the project. Prior experience as the project manager of record on retrofit or plant projects is required; workstream leadership under another project manager is not sufficient. Reports to the head of the retrofit programme; works with the plant managers, the automation vendor and the programme office.

requirements.text: Has been the project manager of record on plant or retrofit projects, signing the charter and the stage-gate submissions.
Holds the project budget under the programme's delegated limits.
Runs plant shutdown windows with the plant managers and directs the assigned project engineers.
Plans and tracks retrofit workstreams under the programme's stage-gate method.
Documents project boundaries, risks and hand-over conditions at each stage gate.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Senior Project Manager, Plant Automation Retrofits

## Experience

- Project engineer, then workstream manager, on the bottling plant automation retrofit programme of a beverage group for five years, running the instrumentation and the control-panel workstreams within retrofit projects run by the programme's project managers.
- Planned and tracked the two workstreams under the programme's stage-gate method, producing the workstream plans, the progress reports and the stage-gate inputs that the project manager of record assembled into the gate submissions.
- Supported the plant shutdown windows at four plants as the workstream manager on site, with the shutdown plan and the shutdown decisions held by the project manager of record and the plant manager.
- Wrote the workstream boundary notes, the workstream risk registers and the hand-over notes for each stage gate, all filed under the project manager of record's gate submissions.
- Budget responsibility was limited to the workstream cost tracking against the allocation set by the project manager of record; no delegated spending limit was held.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the instrumentation workstream plan and progress reports for one retrofit project, the workstream risk register and the hand-over note for gate three, with the programme office's document references as a verification trail; the gate submissions carry the project manager of record's signature.
